founder.title: Hope that doesn’t fade.
founder.bio1: Rev. Benjamin Eturu Adom is the visionary founder of World Ark Missions, a ministry birthed out of a deep passion for God and a divine mandate to touch lives through the power of salvation and transformation.
founder.bio2: From humble beginnings in Afienya, Rev. Adom dedicated his life to prayer, deep scripture teaching, and raising a family of believers whose lives impact society. At World Ark Missions, everyone discovers a genuine home where they can encounter Christ and unlock their God-given destiny.
